clue.text: Street kid appears in magazine over being adopted by travelling funfair

indicators.note: being adopted means taken into a family, so one piece goes inside the other
a travelling show moves about, so the letters of funfair are moved into a new order
over signals turning back, so the short word for magazine is read backwards

explanation.surface: A homeless child turns up in a magazine story about being taken in by a travelling fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'travelling' (the anagram signal) and 'over' (turning the magazine back) both sit naturally in the fairground picture, so the street kid reads as the subject rather than the definition it is.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: an urchin in ragged clothes, the classic scruffy child of the streets.

clue.text: Appreciate dressing for dinner

definitions.meaning: to enjoy or savour something greatly
a sauce or pickle served to add flavour to a meal

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys putting on formal clothes for an evening meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressing for dinner' reads as changing clothes, but here it is a condiment poured over food.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one word: to savour or enjoy, and a tangy condiment such as a chutney.

clue.text: Affable senior officer taking one for the Queen

indicators.note: the officer takes on a new letter in place of one of his own
for means in place of, so one piece swaps out the other

parts.note: a general is a senior army officer
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A friendly high-ranking officer stands in for the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: In GENERAL, the ER (Elizabeth Regina, the Queen) is replaced by I.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: both describe someone friendly, warm and pleasant in manner.

clue.text: Nick, married, is suitable

parts.note: appropriate means suitable or fitting

explanation.surface: Someone named Nick, now married, is deemed a suitable match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' looks like a man's name, but it is the slang verb meaning to steal.
explanation.definitionFit: Nick is British slang for steal, and to take funds or property dishonestly is the same act.

clue.text: Omitted all bar one of the team and lost

parts.note: to forget something is to leave it out

parts.words: all bar one of the team
parts.note: a football or cricket team has eleven players, and eleven minus one is ten

explanation.surface: One player left out of the side, and the match lost.
explanation.walkthrough: The team is a football or cricket eleven, so all but one of them is TEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lost from memory or sight has slipped away, so lost and gone from mind are synonyms here.

clue.text: Dramatist at home infected by disease

indicators.note: something infected has the germ inside it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: someone at home is in
BSE is bovine spongiform encephalopathy, mad cow disease

explanation.surface: A playwright stays indoors, struck down by illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'infected by' signals containment; the disease is mad cow disease, known by its initials.
explanation.definitionFit: Henrik Ibsen was the Norwegian playwright of A Doll's House and Hedda Gabler.

clue.text: Person who rules eastern border going west

indicators.note: in an across answer, going west means running right to left, so the word for border is read backwards

parts.note: a rim is an edge or border

explanation.surface: A ruler extends his frontier westward from the east.
explanation.definitionFit: A Muslim ruler or prince in parts of the Middle East holds this title.

clue.text: Mother with iron disorder — notice artery

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: putting things in disorder jumbles them, so the letters of iron are rearranged

parts.note: an ad, advertisement, is a public notice

explanation.surface: A mother with an iron deficiency spots a blocked blood vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disorder' rearranges IRON to INRO; 'artery' is a busy route, not a blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Artery is used figuratively for a major traffic route, the chief highway through an area.

clue.text: Book girl, not as unforgiving

parts.note: Ruth is a girl's name and a book of the Old Testament
less means not as much

explanation.surface: A girl in a book is described as less forgiving than others.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: merciless, showing no pity or compassion to anyone.

clue.text: Fixer to others worried when importing foreign currency

indicators.note: importing means bringing in, so one piece is placed inside the other
worried means agitated or shaken up, so the letters of to others are rearranged

parts.note: the rouble is the Russian currency

explanation.surface: A fixer is anxious about other people bringing in money from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' rearranges TO OTHERS as TSHOOTER; 'importing' puts ROUBLE inside it after the T.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: someone brought in to resolve problems and sort out difficulties.

clue.text: Boys seen around new estates

indicators.note: the boys go around, so the other piece sits inside them

parts.note: lads are boys

explanation.surface: Some boys are spotted hanging about a newly built housing estate.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is a large area of property, so grounds or acreage owned are synonyms.

clue.text: Coach taken in by others getting control

indicators.note: taken in means contained, so this piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the rest means the others
to coach someone is to train them

explanation.surface: A sports coach is fooled by the others and so gains the upper hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in by' looks like being deceived, but it means placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: holding back or checking oneself is self-control.

clue.text: Mop has gone to pieces, love — this'll fix it!

indicators.note: something gone to pieces has fallen apart, so the letters of mop has are rearranged

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone consoles a friend whose messy hair is a disaster, offering a remedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mop' suggests a cleaning tool but means a shock of hair; the definition plays on that.
explanation.definitionFit: A hair wash sorts out an unruly head of hair, so it is the remedy for a messy mop.

clue.text: Novel-sounding court case — not independent or impartial

indicators.note: sounding means as heard, so the word for novel is taken by sound

parts.note: novel means new

indicators.note: not tells us the letter for independent is removed

parts.note: a trial is a court case

explanation.surface: A trial that seems new is described as neither independent nor fair.
explanation.walkthrough: NEU is how 'new' is said; 'not' removes I from TRIAL to leave TRAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: taking no side in a dispute, unbiased.

clue.text: Minimum requirement to generate reaction, revolutionary racist claims

indicators.note: revolutionary means overturning the order, so the letters of racist claims are rearranged

explanation.surface: A firebrand's bigoted statements are the least needed to provoke a public backlash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reaction' suggests public outrage, but it is a nuclear chain reaction.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics, the smallest amount of fissile material that sustains a nuclear chain reaction.

clue.text: Weather feature that's source of corrosion on antique facade

indicators.note: the source is where something begins, so the first letter of corrosion is taken

parts.note: antique means old
a facade is the front of a building

explanation.surface: A weather mark caused by corrosion on the face of an old building.
explanation.definitionFit: On weather maps, the leading edge of a cold air mass is a standard feature.

clue.text: I like that poet's new elementary forms

parts.note: so means in that way, like that

indicators.note: new means remade, so the letters of poet's are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone praises a poet's fresh, basic forms of verse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges POETS as TOPES; 'elementary' means of a chemical element.
explanation.definitionFit: Variants of a chemical element with differing neutron counts are its forms.

clue.text: Basic technique of a seamstress?

definitions.meaning: read literally, a dressmaker's method that sews no ruffles or gathered trims

explanation.surface: A dressmaker's plain, simple sewing method.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the whimsical literal reading of the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means plain and basic, with no extras, and literally describes sewing without decorative ruffles.

clue.text: Betraying line with first thing to be taken to market

definitions.text: thing to be taken to market

parts.note: shopping is British slang for informing on someone to the police
first is written 1st, and the 1 is read as the letter I

explanation.surface: An informer's first act is to give away a whole line of people.
explanation.walkthrough: To shop someone is British slang for betraying them to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: A note of groceries to buy is literally something carried along to the market.

clue.text: Boyfriend in Germany keeping close

indicators.note: the words keep the answer within them, hidden across their letters

explanation.surface: A girlfriend's boyfriend in Germany stays near at hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close' looks like an adjective meaning near, but it is the noun meaning conclusion.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: the close of a story is its finish or conclusion.

clue.text: House evacuated, surrounded by top command

indicators.note: surrounded means enclosed, so this piece goes inside the other

parts.note: best means top or finest

indicators.note: evacuated means emptied, so only the outer letters of house remain

explanation.surface: An order from the top to empty the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evacuated' means emptied of its middle, leaving only the outside letters; 'surrounded by' places them inside the word for top.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a bidding or instruction given by someone with authority.

clue.text: Dirty, like a lake?

parts.note: a tarn is a small mountain lake
the suffix -ish means somewhat like

explanation.surface: Is something murky like a lake's water?
explanation.walkthrough: Read whimsically, lakeish water is murky, which the question mark allows.
explanation.definitionFit: To dull or sully the surface or reputation of something is to make it dirty.

clue.text: Beautiful young woman appointed time on island

parts.note: the hour is the fixed time for something, as in 'the hour has come'

explanation.surface: A lovely young woman arrives at the agreed time on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: In Islamic tradition, a beautiful maiden of paradise; loosely, any alluring young woman.

clue.text: Walk indignantly away from fringe

definitions.meaning: to storm off in a huff with exaggerated movements
a gathered strip of fabric sewn on a skirt or curtain

explanation.surface: Someone storms off in a temper from the edge of a group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fringe' suggests the edge of a crowd, but here it is a ruffled trim on clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to stride off angrily, and a wide frill sewn on a dress or curtain.

clue.text: Executive committee in favour of keeping nothing built badly

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: pro means in favour of
nothing is zero, which looks like the letter O

indicators.note: badly means wrongly, so the letters of built are rearranged

explanation.surface: A committee supports a building that was poorly put up with no resources.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' signals the anagram and 'keeping' splits the word for in favour of, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief policy-making committee of a Communist party, as in the Soviet Union.

clue.text: Foodstuff requiring journey east ?

parts.note: a trip is a journey

explanation.surface: A food that calls for a voyage to the east.
explanation.definitionFit: The stomach lining of cattle, eaten as an offal dish, is a food.

clue.text: Finally books a quiet band

indicators.note: finally points to the end, so the last letter of books is taken

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: At last a pop group is booked to play quietly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band' is not a music group but a strip of cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: A long strip of fabric worn over the shoulder or round the waist is a band of cloth.

clue.text: Labour facing Tory inheritance

parts.note: labour is giving birth
the right is the conservative side of politics

explanation.surface: The Labour party lines up against the Conservatives over inherited wealth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' and 'Tory' look like British political parties, but labour means childbirth here.
explanation.definitionFit: Something one is entitled to by being born into a family, such as a legacy.
